template.name: Stoch TP TS V3103
template.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,{p0}), sma(rsi(close,{p1}),{p2})) and rsi(close,5) > {p0} and rsi(close,5) < {p1}
template.notes: The stochastic is approximated by RSI(5) with an SMA(3) percent-D line, and the documented 20 to 80 range is kept as the band the cross must occur inside. The fixed minute of each hour, the initial stop, the three-times take-profit and the trailing switch are not expressible in the DSL.
